title: Dr Souc - Gas
htmlContent:
Dr Souc's "Gas"  is a must listen for every music lover out there. He displays excellence from the beginning to end. From the sharp lyrics that shows how incredible his pen is, the signature exhilarating flow that brings excitement, and it’s all over a beat that sounds tailor made for him to snap on. The song is about enjoying the simplicity of life, and he delivers the message with his amazing sophistication of his style.
